division: Transport Department of NCT of Delhi
description: The DL-07 RTO is the zonal office for East Delhi District-I located at the Mayur Vihar DTC Depot. It serves as a central hub for transport services including vehicle registration, driving licenses, and permits for the eastern part of the National Capital Territory. This office manages a high volume of transport administrative tasks for the trans-Yamuna region.
address: DTC Depot, Mayur Vihar Phase I, Delhi
